title: RunCheckpoint
description: A durable record of one completed unit of work within a run, keyed by (runId, taskId). Written after a subagent succeeds so a crashed or interrupted swarm can resume: on re-invocation with the same runId, tasks with a checkpoint are restored instead of re-run, and only the missing/failed tasks execute. Only successful ('ok') results are checkpointed - a partial or errored result is intentionally left uncheckpointed so it re-runs on resume. See reference/multi-agent-architecture-notes.md section 12 (durable/resumable execution).

runId.description: The run this checkpoint belongs to. Resuming means re-invoking the orchestrator with this same runId.

taskId.description: The subagent task this checkpoint restores. Unique within a run - the resume key.

result.description: The AgentResult produced by the completed subagent, restored verbatim on resume. Its status is always 'ok' - see the checkpoint policy above.
